verdict.rationale: Loops' docs confirm campaign creation via editor/Content API, audience segmentation, and dashboard-based review/send (loops-docs-5, loops-docs-18, loops-docs-31, loops-docs-16), and marketing-email page explicitly frames 'create a campaign, build an audience segment, send a newsletter' as the core flow. However, evidence emphasizes drafting campaigns via API 'straight from the API. Review and send from the dashboard' rather than a fully documented native compose+schedule UI flow, and no direct documentation of a 'schedule for later' feature is shown. missing for 10: explicit scheduling/send-later documentation, independent hands-on account of the full compose-audience-send flow, more detail on native campaign UI beyond editor basics.
